correctness.rationale: Every statement is quantified over positive a,b,g,q and initial t≥0. A three-rectangle offset inclusion–exclusion isolates two identical L-notch terms and a disjoint-arm intersection. The exact L quadrant integral gives the positive cubic coefficient, the overlapping upper-half disk lens gives (4/3)sqrt(g) s^(3/2), and the surviving channel strip gives 2(q−g/2)s in the deep regime. At equality the upper cap truncation affects only order s². All remainders and signs follow at fixed parameters and imply sharp supremal polynomial reach.
